name: Hossein Raghfar
notes: Prominent institutional economist at Alzahra University; advocate of wealth taxation and financial capital taxes to reduce systemic inequality.

name: Arsalan Fathi-Pour
role: Member of Parliament for Kalibar; Chairman of the Economic Commission (9th Majlis)
notes: Chairman of the Majlis Economic Commission during the 2012-2013 Direct Taxes Reform Bill discussions; introduced the proposal for a 0.2% annual net wealth tax on assets over 2 billion tomans.

name: Vahid Shaghaghi Shahri
role: Associate Professor of Economics, Dean of Faculty of Economics
notes: Economist and Dean of Faculty of Economics at Kharazmi University; explicitly proposed wealth taxes on top deciles and an exit tax on capital flight and emigration.

name: Masoud Saadatmehr
notes: Economist at Payame Noor University; co-authored empirical study on wealth tax and inequality in Iran applying Piketty's theory.

name: Afshin Bazgir
notes: Economist at Payame Noor University; co-authored empirical study on wealth tax and inequality in Iran applying Piketty's theory.

name: Mohammad Javad Tavakkoli
role: Associate Professor of Economics, Head of the Economic Affairs Research Institute
affiliation: Ministry of Economic Affairs and Finance
notes: Head of the Economic Affairs Research Institute at the Ministry of Economy; convened the December 2022 symposium on wealth tax principles and advocated wealth taxation to regulate unproductive assets.

name: Mohammad Reza Yazdi-Zadeh
role: Economist, Former Member of the Strategic Council of the Tax Administration
notes: Economist and former Strategic Council member of the National Tax Administration; detailed the structural necessity of wealth taxation to prevent excessive wealth concentration.
